about: Three test vectors for the challenge stamp of poiesis-insight 2.0.0. `text` is the conclusion's sentence as it is found; `normalised` is what is hashed (UTF-8). The same vectors are in challenge-stamp-format.md.

vectors.name: plain: one line, with an en dash and a per cent sign that stay as typed
vectors.text: Machines, AI and robots is the fastest-growing major area of moral research. Its share of the universe went from 0.4% (2015) to 6.9% (2025), growing about 20% a year in 2020–25, down from about 46% in 2015–20.
vectors.normalised: Machines, AI and robots is the fastest-growing major area of moral research. Its share of the universe went from 0.4% (2015) to 6.9% (2025), growing about 20% a year in 2020–25, down from about 46% in 2015–20.

vectors.name: layout and accents: wrapped lines, a tab, double spaces, a carriage return, and letters typed as a base letter plus a combining mark
vectors.text:
